newsitem.title: USA: Inland says holder backs Ryerson spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Inland says holder backs Ryerson spin-off.

text.p: Inland Steel Industries Inc said one of its shareholders, Greenway Partners LP, proposed a spin-off of Inland's remaining 87 percent interest in Ryerson Tull Inc.
Inland completed an initial public offering of Ryerson Tull last year.

In a statement dated February 22, Inland said its board had considered a spin-off of Ryerson Tull and recently concluded that such a move at this time was not in the best interests of its shareholders.
Inland said its board and management were committed to creating shareholder value and would continue to look at all strategic options, including a spin-off of Ryerson Tull.
